title: Visualisations
headline: The flying-fish blueprint is drawn in 3D at /blueprint3d/ with its genes: 536 distinct ontology terms (13 organ systems, 67 organs, 198 tissues, 257 cell types), 674 part_of edges, and one gene marker on each of the 79 nodes that has a direct proxy-fish record in the vetted genotype map (genotype/map.vetted.slim.json, a committed source, so a clean checkout reproduces the page) (body 1/1, organ systems 8/13, organs 28/67, tissues 29/198, cell types 14/257); every gene section says the records were measured in zebrafish or medaka, never in a flying fish, and that a node with no record is unstudied, not gene-free. Each node also shows its term, the SPARQL query that produced it, and the kernel-checked structural certificate that covers it beside the biological Lean statement it does not have (0 of 536 terms appear in any Lean statement). /graph/ hides its 213 datasets by default and its Ideas view reads 12 ideas: 4 researched, 5 reach-synthesis (not yet checked against prior art), 3 serendipitous.
